_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro: O jẹ Player {player_id} ninu {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game. Awọn ofin: - Ni akoko rẹ, o le: 1) Ṣe ifilọlẹ tuntun pẹlu iye ti o ga julọ tabi oju ti o ga julọ (tabi awọn mejeeji) ju ifilọlẹ lọwọlọwọ; ie '[Bid: 3, 4]', 2) Pe ifilọlẹ ikẹhin nipa titẹ '[Call]'. Ti o ba pe: - Ti iye gangan ti iye oju yẹn laarin gbogbo awọn dice ba kere ju ifilọlẹ, olutẹtisi ikẹhin padanu ọkan die. - Bibẹkọkọ, olutẹtisi padanu ọkan die. Ẹrọ ti o de 0 die ni a yọ kuro. Ẹrọ ti o ku kẹhin ti o ṣẹgun.

board.new_round: Ìyí tuntun - Ìyókù ìdì: {dice_summary} Ìdì rẹ ti o wà lọwọlọwọ ni: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is LESS than {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the last bidder) loses one die.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} calls! The actual count of face {face_value} is {count}, which is >= {quantity}.
Player {loser_id} (the caller) loses one die.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: A pe wọn láìṣe ìfilọ̀ kankan.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Ase ko ri bi '[Bid: X, Y]' ti o ni atilakai tabi '[Call]'. Ase ti a fowo: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Iye tuntun {new_quantity} kere ju iye ti o wa lọwọlọwọ {current_quantity} lọ.
bid_reason.face_lower: Iye ojú tuntun {new_face_value} kò tó iye tí ó wà nísinsìnyí {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Àdéhùn náà bá ohun tí wọ́n ń sọ báyìí mu.
bid_reason.face_range: Iye tí ó yẹ kí ó wà láàárín 1 àti 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Ẹ̀yà {player_id} ti yọkuro nítorí ìgbésẹ̀ tí kò bágbà mu.
